==Comments==
*As noted above, these words state a relationship, and not an entire [[bridi|bridi]], so a better word would [[selbrivla|selbrivla]], i.e. ''valsi lo selbri'' (a word which means a [[selbri|selbri]]).
*Why isn't it [[brivo|brivo]]?
**If '''vo''' was a rafsi for valsi for purposes of making a few new gismu (cmavo = cmalu valsi, lujvo = pluja valsi), why not for this one?
